recommendations.claim: Bodyweight hip hinge pattern (Romanian deadlift variation) builds posterior chain activation under load tolerance assessment conditions.
recommendations.source: McGill (2015) Low Back Disorders; Hides et al. (2001) lumbar multifidus reactivation post-episode
recommendations.reversibility: Regress to standing hip hinge drill if any posterior referral or >3/10 discomfort; advance load only after clinician clearance

payload.name: Bodyweight Romanian Deadlift
payload.detail: Hinge at hip, soft knee, neutral spine throughout. Pause at end range with deliberate glute engagement on return. Stop if any posterior leg referral or sharp lumbar sensation.

recommendations.claim: Quadruped bird-dog restores lumbopelvic stability via anti-extension demand without spinal loading.
recommendations.source: McGill et al. (2009) 'Exercises for the torso'; Richardson et al. (1999) segmental stabilization
recommendations.reversibility: Regress to dead-bug if pelvis cannot remain neutral; progression to loaded variation deferred until clearance

payload.name: Bird-Dog
payload.detail: From quadruped, brace lightly, extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously. Hold 2-3 sec at full extension. Pelvis stays square - no rotation or hip hike. Return under control.

recommendations.claim: Glute bridge targets hip extensors and lumbar offloading in a supine, spine-friendly position.
recommendations.source: Andersen et al. (2015) glute activation review; Reiman et al. (2012) hip abductor/extensor EMG
recommendations.reversibility: Bilateral only at this stage; single-leg variant and added load deferred until clinician clearance

payload.name: Glute Bridge
payload.detail: Supine, feet flat, hip-width. Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at top, avoid lumbar hyperextension. 2 sec hold at top. Controlled descent.

recommendations.claim: Low-incline dumbbell press (bench angle 30-45 degrees) preserves upper-body pressing capacity within a horizontal vector.
recommendations.source: NSCA Essentials of Strength Training (4th ed.); Schoenfeld (2010) hypertrophy review
recommendations.reversibility: Light load only at this return phase; load increment deferred to clinician-clearance session; stop if any shoulder impingement signal

payload.name: Low-Incline Dumbbell Press (30-45 deg)
payload.detail: Control the descent, neutral wrist, elbows ~45 deg flare. Move with intent, not momentum. Deferred loading - select a weight that produces mild effort at rep 10 with no joint pain.

recommendations.claim: Chest-supported dumbbell row builds horizontal pulling volume without axial spinal loading.
recommendations.source: Schoenfeld (2010) back hypertrophy review; Fenwick et al. (2009) lumbar loading comparison
recommendations.reversibility: Chest-supported variant preferred if unsupported hip hinge loads the back uncomfortably; load progression deferred until clearance

payload.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
payload.detail: Bench at low incline, chest contact maintained throughout. Retract scapula before initiating pull. Elbow tracks body angle, no rotation. Hold 1 sec at peak contraction.
